name: Forms
description: Contact forms with protected submissions and optional email alerts
author: Click CMS

settings.title: Form email alerts
settings.description: Get an email when someone sends a contact form. Messages are always saved under Submissions, even if an email fails.

fields.name: to
fields.label: Send alerts to
fields.help: The person who should be notified about new messages.

fields.name: from
fields.label: Sender email address
fields.help: Use an address your website is allowed to send from. Your hosting provider can confirm this.

settings.privacyHelp: Alerts contain a reference to the saved message, without the visitor’s personal details.

action.label: Send test email
action.dirtyHelp: Save your changes before sending a test email.
action.successMessage: The mail server accepted the test email. Check the recipient’s inbox and spam folder to confirm delivery.

settings.help: After sending a test, check the recipient’s inbox and spam folder. If it does not arrive, ask your hosting provider to check email sending.
